status: CANDIDATO PARA REVISIÓN, SIN ACTIVACIÓN | revisión candidata r2 de la gramática de selectores (compatible), sin activación
supersedes: CA2-2X-PRECISION-1 (candidate of 2026-09-27, never active; see historico/)
reason_for_version: review finding R3: v1 checked that shared_denominator was an existing selector whose primitives matched it, but not that it was the PIB member of the authenticated vector; a COE member labelled 'PIB' passed
extends: CA2-2 (catalogo_contratos.json), which remains active and unchanged
scope: payload of precision_rule inside a CA2 evidence receipt with role 'precision'; the receipt envelope (facts, outcome, precision_rule, common_conflicts) is unchanged

dispatch.no contract_version: CA2-2 meaning; never re-read per primitive
dispatch.CA2-2X-PRECISION-1: superseded candidate: not accepted, not re-read as v2 (interpret -> superseded_candidate_not_accepted)
dispatch.CA2-2X-PRECISION-2+SYNTHETIC-NOT-EVIDENC: test-support output only; rejected by validate() whenever emitted, never evidence

new_in_v2.vector_binding: {snapshot_sha256, projection_sha256}; projection = [[concept, member_selector], ...] read from the AUTHENTICATED snapshot bytes, in facts.selectors order; projection_sha256 = SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (separators ',' ':', UTF-8)
new_in_v2.consumer_input: validate(rule, projection, cells=..., snapshot_sha256=..., emitted=True): the consumer derives the projection itself from authenticated bytes; the rule never supplies it
new_in_v2.concept_check: every selector_rules[].concept equals the projection concept of that selector
new_in_v2.denominator_check: the projection contains exactly one 'PIB' member; shared_denominator.concept == 'PIB', member_selector == that member, primitives == its parsed terms

unchanged_from_v1.kind: rounding | exact | mixed (mixed iff both kinds present)
unchanged_from_v1.primitives: value, kind, rounding_unit (null for exact), domain [v-u/2, v+u/2] or [0,0], rule_id, evidence_ids, correspondence, basis, status (ok | pending_review)
unchanged_from_v1.selector_rules: explicit terms equal to the member selector parse; member_domain propagated with shared primitives grouped
unchanged_from_v1.emission: an emitted PASS rule contains only primitives with status ok

consumer_checks: version dispatch; synthetic rules never emitted
exact field sets at every level
binding to the authenticated projection and snapshot
primitive domain recomputed from value and unit; stored non-formula cell when cells are given; exact zero only for blank/zero cells
terms equal the member selector parse; member domain recomputed with shared primitives grouped
selector concepts equal the authenticated projection; shared denominator is its unique PIB member

member_selector_grammar.revision: r2 candidata (consolidación 1.4, 27-09-2026): el cero semántico documentado puede aparecer dentro de un miembro compuesto (ruta neta PER, D-02)
member_selector_grammar.compatibility: superconjunto: todo selector válido antes se interpreta igual; no existía ningún recibo emitido con la forma nueva; una primitiva no puede repetirse dentro de un mismo miembro
